info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Corporate Finance By Param1-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information on corporate tax advisory services based on specific parameters. It serves as a key resource for finance teams, tax consultants, and corporate clients seeking insights into tax optimization and compliance. The operation aids in accessing valuable data that supports informed decision-making and strategic planning. Typically, this API is utilized by financial professionals to analyze tax advisory options and align them with corporate finance strategies.

get.description: Fetch the details of the corporate tax advisory service with the specified ID. This endpoint provides all relevant information for the selected advisory, allowing users to understand the services offered.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve data related to corporate tax advisory services for the specified resource. It must provide the necessary information in JSON format to effectively process the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested tax advisory data.
